# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI backports**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM corrections and a WinUI .NET 9 fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library TFMs now use versioned Apple targets (e.g. ios26.0) and application TFMs use unversioned forms, matching Apple platform conventions and fixing downstream build warnings. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — The WinUI native projection DLL was not being located correctly for .NET 9 consumers. The asset resolution is now correct. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
